main_text.p:
Istius aui decadis annum metiens,
Idemque semper olim qui fuit manens.
At putido tu fœtidus mendacio.
Et factus ex Clemente Dementissimus,
Putes suel ipsis iam tuis sodalibus,
Vel putet istis iam nihil, quos nil pudet.
Hinc ipse sero Beza st evolaverit,
Mille sunius mox pro deuntibus loco,
Quam sestra sana fuerit expectatio,
Exosa sobis vos docebit seritas.
main_text.head: Illustri & Generosissimo Domino, Domino Ioanni RvthvENO, Comiti Gaurex, Domino Ruthueniæ &c.
main_text.p:
Quod Bezæ adsingis minimè quæ Beza meretur,
Quilibet hoc faciat, pictor, faciátque poeta,
At quod tam dextrè, tam culte talia fingis,
Præstiterit rarus pictor, rarúsque poeta.
Scin' sero exoptet quanam tibi Beza sicilsim?
Vt quam adscripta sibi sunt istæc pleraque sitte,
Tam cunctis hæc in te miremur sut omnia sere.

page.notes: The Greek-style and decorative woodcut initial "O" at the start of the epigram is read as O; lower portion of page is stains and show-through, not transcribed. Several words in the Latin verse are uncertain due to the italic type and damage (e.g. "st evolaverit", "sunius", "sicilsim") and should be checked against the scan.
